observations.evidence: The root-layout canonical was removed and the homepage now owns its explicit canonical. A production HTTP check returned homepage 200 with https://yungyanggogo.kr and missing nutrition detail 404 with noindex and no canonical.
observations.verification: scripts/test-canonical-metadata-boundary.mjs passed 2 assertions; typecheck, lint and production build passed; live local production HTML confirmed the boundary.

observations.evidence: The current corpus map keeps 700 legacy rows behind review boundaries; only the seed blog detail is exposed by the local production build and seven researched candidates remain pending/noindex.
observations.minimumFix: Continue replacing or merging legacy contracts only after distinct intent, research, originality, QA and human approval are evidenced.
observations.verification: Regenerate the corpus and readiness reports, run editorial boundary tests, then inspect the production route manifest.

observations.evidence: No repository CMP/TCF implementation was observed. Visitor regions, live ad mode and AdSense privacy-message configuration were not available to this local audit.
observations.minimumFix: Before enabling personalized ads, verify the live consent design and account configuration for the actual visitor regions.
observations.verification: Use a live browser with regional test conditions and inspect consent, storage and ad requests without clicking ads.

observations.evidence: .env.example defaults NEXT_PUBLIC_ADSENSE_ENABLED to false; the sampled local build therefore emitted no AdSense loader.
observations.minimumFix: No local code change. Verify the intended production environment separately before any review or rollout.
observations.verification: Inspect the deployed environment and page source through an authorized read-only check.

positiveSignals: public/ads.txt contains the same publisher identifier as lib/site.ts
AdSense loading is controlled by an explicit environment flag and a narrow real-detail route gate
About, contact, privacy, terms and editorial-policy routes returned 200 in the local production smoke
Sampled indexable HTML emitted self-referencing yungyanggogo.kr canonicals, and a missing detail no longer inherits the homepage canonical
robots, sitemap index, core sitemap, feed, ads.txt and llms.txt returned 200 with expected content types
Organization, WebSite, Article and Breadcrumb structured data exist in the relevant templates

decision.reason: A local repository audit cannot establish current AdSense account status, live consent behavior, deployed crawl behavior or approval eligibility.
